connector.name: A0nexus Bitcoin MCP
connector.registryDescription: Crypto (BTC/ETH) + ERCOT electricity data & forecasts as MCP tools. Pay-per-call via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package a0nexus-bitcoin-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the a0nexus-bit account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: BTCI_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the a0nexus API.

env.name: BTCI_MCP_PAYMENT
env.description: Set to 'real' to enable the paid tools (otherwise only the free tools work).

env.name: BTCI_MCP_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Base wallet private key used to pay for paid tools when BTCI_MCP_PAYMENT=real.
